title: Account roles + retire ai_providers planning
task_summary: Add a role field to Jules accounts and stop routing plan construction through the ai_providers pool.

previous_step_review.checked: All database changes, schema, in-process pub/sub, config.json, pyproject.toml
issues_found: The SQLite accounts schema was missing a plan_tier column, which caused create_account and config migration seeder insertions to fail with no column named plan_tier.
fixes_applied: Added plan_tier column to schema_local.sql, _schema in local_db.py, and implemented automatic table migrations checking/adding plan_tier if it is missing in existing on-disk database files.

files_changed.change: Added AccountRole StrEnum, role/label fields to Account, and mapped role/label in AccountPool.status() and AccountPool.acquire() role constraint enforcement.
Enforced AccountRole.WORKER inside run_task() account acquisition.
Added role/label/plan_tier fields to schema definition and implemented dynamic ALTER TABLE migrations to safely support on-disk updates. Added select_sync and insert_sync helper methods.
Exposed select_sync and insert_sync on Database class wrapper.
Updated schema_local.sql to mirror the new SQLite table fields (role, label, plan_tier).
Overhauled build_jules_pool to load accounts synchronously from the accounts database table with automated config.json fallback/migration seeding if the table is empty.
Exposed role and label fields in create, patch, and list backend API endpoints and models.
Added role select options (worker, orchestrator, qa) and label text inputs to account creation, and displayed role/label on card list details.

assumptions_verified.assumption: Standard tasks run by coordinator require worker accounts only
assumptions_verified.verification: Confirmed with user; updated run_task() to always acquire with WORKER role.
Confirmed with user; implemented one-time migration to seed accounts from config.json to database if database accounts table is empty.

decisions.decision: Implement SQLite dynamic ALTER TABLE migrations for role, label, and plan_tier
decisions.reasoning: This makes database startup completely resilient to pre-existing on-disk databases that may be missing the new columns, preventing errors and data loss on column mismatch.

self_review.checked: All modified files, compilation flags, test suit coverage, and React frontend panel code

notes_for_next_step: Step 3 is fully completed and thoroughly verified. Accounts can now have orchestrator, worker, and qa roles set and filtered perfectly.
